budgets.title: Budgets & alerts
budgets.lead: Monthly spending caps per category with an early-warning threshold. You're alerted before a budget is blown, not after.
budgets.lines_sub: Sorted by how much of the budget is used
budgets.period_help: Leave empty to apply the budget to every month.
budgets.how: Marketing, delivery, inventory and payroll budgets are measured from their own modules; every other budget is measured from expenses in that category. Crossing the threshold or the cap sends an in-app alert once per month.
budgets.empty_text: Set a monthly cap for rent, marketing, payroll or any expense category to get early warnings.
